anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the report view apply to active filters when the user switches workspaces?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch - each workspace opens unfiltered, and nothing is stored between switches
B) preserve all active filters across switches - the current handler behavior in ui/report-view.ts becomes the explicit policy, and filters from one workspace carry into the next
C) restore each workspace's last filters - switching back returns that workspace's own filters, which needs a stored filter set for each workspace
Recommendation: C - filters usually describe one workspace's data, so carrying them over (B) can hide results in the next workspace, while clearing them (A) throws away the user's work; the cost is per-workspace filter storage alongside the resolver-owned policy.

How should filters behave when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves the current behavior without adding per-workspace state.
